description: This file contains functions and types for creating backups, including building archive paths, handling filesystem operations, and generating backup manifests. It is part of a backup utility in a larger project.

methods.name: resolveOutputPath
methods.description: Determines the output path for the backup archive based on user input, current directory, and included assets.

methods.name: assertOutputPathReady
methods.description: Checks if the output path is available for writing, throws error if file exists.

methods.name: buildTempArchivePath
methods.description: Generates a temporary archive file path with a UUID suffix.

methods.name: isLinkUnsupportedError
methods.description: Checks if an error code indicates that hard links are unsupported.

methods.name: publishTempArchive
methods.description: Attempts to move the temporary archive to the final output location, using link or copy methods.

methods.name: canonicalizePathForContainment
methods.description: Resolves a path to its canonical form, handling symlinks and parent directories.

methods.name: buildManifest
methods.description: Creates a backup manifest object with metadata, assets, and skipped entries.

methods.name: formatBackupCreateSummary
methods.description: Generates a human-readable summary of the backup creation result.

methods.name: remapArchiveEntryPath
methods.description: Remaps archive entry paths, replacing the manifest.json path with a relative archive path.

methods.name: createBackupArchive
methods.description: Main function to create a backup archive, handling planning, filesystem operations, and archive creation.
